subtitle: Strength and weight loss at 46: three dumbbell sessions at home, two cardio days, yoga and plenty of walking.
safety: Check with the doctor before starting, especially with joint pain or any other health concerns.
Strength training matters most: muscle and bone are lost faster after 40, and lifting slows that down. Add 1 to 2 kg when the top of the rep range feels easy.
Form before weight. Breathe out as you lift; never hold your breath.
Stay cool: train in a cool, airy room, wear light layers and keep cold water nearby.
If jumping or heavy lifts cause leaking or heaviness low in the pelvis, skip the hops, keep up the Kegels and ask the doctor about a pelvic floor physiotherapist.
Stop for sharp joint pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness. Call for an ambulance for chest pain or pressure, fainting, sudden weakness or trouble speaking.
Sleep 7 to 8 hours; poor sleep makes weight loss much harder.

tiles.tip: Pick a weight where the last 2 reps are hard but clean. Rest 60 to 90 sec between sets.

moves.name: Warm-up
moves.tip: Marching, arm circles, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 hip hinges, then one light set of the first exercise.

moves.name: Goblet squat
moves.tip: Hold one dumbbell at the chest, sit between the heels.

moves.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
moves.tip: Lower slowly for 2 to 3 seconds.

moves.name: One-arm dumbbell row
moves.tip: Hand and knee on the bench, back flat.
moves.q: one arm dumbbell row bench form

moves.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
moves.tip: Hips back, back flat, dumbbells close to the legs.

moves.name: Small hops
moves.tip: Little jumps on the spot, soft landings. Impact helps keep bones strong. Skip if you have leaking, knee pain or have been told you have osteoporosis.
moves.q: low impact bone density jumps women

moves.name: Dead bug
moves.tip: Lower back stays on the floor.

moves.name: Pelvic floor (Kegels)
moves.tip: Squeeze as if stopping the flow of urine, relax fully between. Do these every day.

moves.name: Cool-down stretch
moves.tip: Hamstrings, hips, chest and shoulders.

moves.tip: A 10-minute walk after each meal also helps blood sugar and appetite.
